outgoing.name: Church of Ireland
outgoing.excerpt: Many were once held by clergymen of the Church of Ireland, then established church.

outgoing.name: Diamond
outgoing.excerpt: In 1831, however, William IV presented the Grand Master with a star and badge, each composed of rubies, emeralds and Brazilian diamonds.

outgoing.name: Dublin
outgoing.excerpt: The Chapel of the Order was originally in St Patrick's Cathedral, Dublin.

outgoing.name: Northern Ireland
outgoing.excerpt: The position, insofar as it related to Northern Ireland, was combined with that of Norroy King of Arms (the heraldic authority in north England).

outgoing.name: Scotland
outgoing.excerpt: The Scottish equivalent is The Most Ancient and Most Noble Order of the Thistle, dating in its modern form to 1687.
